description: In a green corner panel of the marble floor in the grand lobby, orange marble outlines a classic Hidden Mickey. The panel is easiest to pick out from the upper balcony, with the whole floor in view.

whereToLook.scene: Marble floor of the grand lobby
whereToLook.exactSpot: A green panel in a corner of the floor. Look for orange marble in a three-circle outline.

bestTip: Look from the upper balcony first to find the panel, then go down.
